messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — GPU pool saturation at customer AcmeHealth private cluster (vc-acme-01). queued_requests=1.2k, avg_latency=4.8s, error_rate=0.6% — paging oncall
Mia (SRE): looking. acked. grabbing logs and current scale state
Ashwin (eng-runtime): saw increased qps from customer after 11:32 UTC, models with long context are spiking tokens. autoscaler should add nodes but not seeing new nodes boot
Kevin (oncall): i'm oncall. checking autoscaler logs now
Mia (SRE): `kubectl -n acme get nodes | grep gpu` shows 3 ready gpu nodes, pool max=3 -> hm
Kevin (oncall): can someone dump the cluster-autoscaler object?
Ashwin (eng-runtime): paste: ```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v1
kind: ClusterAutoscaler
spec:
  minNodes: 1
  maxNodes: 3
  scaleUpDelay: 30s
  scaleDownDelay: 10m
```
Leah (support): customer is seeing request queue growth and their health checks for inference are failing intermittently. they're on our private deployment SLA
Mia (SRE): checking provisioning events: images failing to pull for new nodes, `ImagePullBackOff` on init containers from internal registry acme-registry.local:443
Ashwin (eng-runtime): that registry is only available via a peered private endpoint in their VPC. iam role and certs ok historically. getting TLS handshake error from kubelet logs: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`
Kevin (oncall): ok. so autoscaler requests nodes but they never become Ready because kubelet cannot pull init image -> node stuck in NotReady -> autoscaler hits maxNodes and stops scaling -> queue grows. confirmed customer impact.
Mia (SRE): mitigation options: 1) bump maxNodes temporary, 2) fix registry certs, 3) reroute heavy requests to hosted fallback or quantized model. we should do short-term to restore traffic.
Leah (support): customer is requesting update. they're seeing 504s. need ETA
Ashwin (eng-runtime): increasing maxNodes alone won't help if nodes can't pull images and join. but we can spin up nodes with a force-bypass: use pre-baked AKI image that already contains model init blobs (works in air-gapped cases) — need cloud quota and approvals
Mia (SRE): i'll try a manual scale with a prebaked image in their cluster pool. starting now.
Ops-Rotation Bot: Deploy job queued by Mia — `deploy/emergency-prebake` initiated
Deploy-Bot: Job started on pool vc-acme-01-prebake-evac (3 instances)
Kevin (oncall): i'm creating a temporary traffic-weight change to shift 30% of AcmeHealth traffic to hosted fallback. Leah can you notify customer that we're redirecting some traffic to hosted fallback model to reduce queue and latency?
Leah (support): yep i'll message them: "we're diverting up to 30% to a hosted, quantized fallback to reduce latency while we restore their private node provisioning" — sending now :email:
Mia (SRE): prebaked nodes booting. logs show kubelet started and node registered. `kubectl -n acme get nodes` now shows +3 nodes Ready
Ashwin (eng-runtime): nice. autoscaler still at max 3 so cluster now has 6 effective gpu nodes because we created emergency pool. routing changes should start draining queue in ~30s
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: metric alert: queued_requests dropped from 1200 -> 320 in 2m
Kevin (oncall): monitoring model quality on fallback. need to watch errors and cost delta. set temporary rate-limits if error spikes
Mia (SRE): starting controlled drain of older nodes once jobs finish. also triggering an on-call handoff to morning SRE @Ops-Rotation in 20m for followup 
Ashwin (eng-runtime): root cause: autoscaler maxNodes was misconfigured during recent capacity refactor (value 3 set per pool template). follow-up action: patch CI template, add validation to infra-configs, and add an alert when cluster reaching maxNodes and avg_pod_pending>5 for >2m
Leah (support): customer update sent: "we've diverted some traffic to a hosted fallback and spun up emergency pre-baked capacity; latency improving; we'll follow up with permanent remediation plan." they asked for RCA and timeline ~2 business days.
Kevin (oncall): handing off to morning SRE rotation, details pinned in thread. @Ops-Rotation take it from here, please confirm postmortem owner
Ops-Rotation Bot: acknowledged handoff to Ops-Rotation. Reminder: please run post-incident checklist and schedule 2h RCA meeting
Mia (SRE): quick notes for postmortem: 1) autoscaler maxNodes misconfig during refactor 2) image pull TLS validation not surfaced in preflight 3) no alert for "reached maxNodes + pending pods" 4) emergency prebake procedure worked but not automated for this customer
Ashwin (eng-runtime): action items I'll own: patch template, add CI guard, add autoscaler telemetry. Mia please own runbook updates for emergency prebake and handoff steps. Leah to own customer comms + follow-up
Leah (support): got it. i'll open a support ticket and draft RCA for AcmeHealth
Kevin (oncall): closing pager. if anything regresses ping me. great job team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident closed by Kevin (oncall) — duration 54m, customer impact: partial (timeouts and increased latency), mitigation: emergency pre-baked nodes + traffic diversion, next steps: RCA and config guard
